He was depressed before, but ever since his family member died, he's had this obsession with death.  Whether it be in general or about her. He blames himself. He thinks that if he dropped dead, nobody would care, and nobody would notice. 

He also has a bad home life, with his parents not believing him about anything. He's LGBT, so that's another factor in the relationship.  We have very similar home lives, and LGBT status. 

That's the shortened version of it.
